entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Thank you, Jane. I see you ordered the VeloFit Aero helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The color is just wrong. Doesn't match my bike at all. It's not a big deal, the box is unopened.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the helmet was delivered 47 days ago.
And you're all set. Our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're within that window, I can process this return for you right now.
Great. A simple problem with a simple solution. Imagine that.

Of course. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with important safety gear like a helmet. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label for you now. I'll email it to the address on file. Is that okay?

The email has been sent. Once our warehouse receives the item and confirms the box is unopened, your full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You'll receive a notification as soon as it's processed. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
